items.title: Lily Blanc
items.blurb: A translucent milk base under a glazed top coat, each nail drawn with a single lily in white on white. The quietest set we make.
items.image_alt: A macro photograph of the Lily Blanc set — glazed milk
items.hand_alt: The same hand wearing the Lily Blanc press-on set

items.title: Orchid Veil
items.blurb: Blush pink pressed thin enough to read the nail beneath, with an aurora pearl that pulls lilac in daylight and peach under lamps.
items.image_alt: A macro photograph of the Orchid Veil set — aurora pearl
items.hand_alt: The same hand wearing the Orchid Veil press-on set

items.title: Matcha Latte
items.blurb: Sage folded into warm cream and left to marble, no two nails alike. Finished satin, so it reads matte until the light catches it.
items.image_alt: A macro photograph of the Matcha Latte set — satin marble
items.hand_alt: The same hand wearing the Matcha Latte press-on set

items.title: Cherry Gloss
items.blurb: Layered translucent red until it holds depth like glass. The gloss is the whole point — it stays wet-looking for the life of the set.
items.image_alt: A macro photograph of the Cherry Gloss set — jelly gloss
items.hand_alt: The same hand wearing the Cherry Gloss press-on set

items.title: Étoile
items.blurb: A mirror chrome that borrows the colour of whatever room you walk into, with crystals set by hand into small four-point stars.
items.image_alt: A macro photograph of the Étoile set — mirror chrome
items.hand_alt: The same hand wearing the Étoile press-on set

items.title: Bunny Cream
items.blurb: A milky nude with a glazed-doughnut sheen, and on two nails a rabbit the size of a grain of rice wearing a blush bow.
items.image_alt: A macro photograph of the Bunny Cream set — glazed pearl
items.hand_alt: The same hand wearing the Bunny Cream press-on set

items.title: Amour
items.blurb: Ten nails on one theme — hearts poured in jelly red, a soda bottle and a love letter built up in relief, and a gingham bow sculpted by hand.
items.image_alt: A macro photograph of the Amour set — jelly crimson
items.hand_alt: The same hand wearing the Amour press-on set
